verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no mention of managed Slurm, managed Kubernetes, or any cluster job scheduler. It documents individual VMs (Machines), containers-as-a-service for serving models (Deployments), and ML pipeline automation (Workflows). These are adjacent features, not a managed Slurm or Kubernetes scheduler, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can schedule jobs on managed Slurm or Kubernetes instead of building my own scheduler on raw nodes
